help.stdout:
usage: gnd export ilp [-h] [--labels LABELS] [--population POPULATION]
                      --target {popper,neutral,ilasp,rules,amie} --out OUT
                      model

Write the learner-neutral ILP form (gnd-ilp/1) of MODEL and a class-mode label
manifest, plus the named adapter's rendering, into a new directory. Examples
are the manifest's populations; the learned predicate wrong/1 covers the
negative class. The amie target instead takes one --population and no labels,
and writes its binary fact types as typed triples. Prints the export digest,
the SHA-256 of export.json. Exits 0 on success, 3 on an invalid manifest,
model or population or a value the export cannot render, 5 when a population
fails to load, 11 when --out exists, 64 on a usage error, 66 on a missing
input, 74 on a refused path.

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --labels LABELS       class-mode label manifest (gnd-labels/1); required by
                        every target but amie
  --population POPULATION
                        the one population to export; required by amie,
                        refused by the others
  --target {popper,neutral,ilasp,rules,amie}
                        learner adapter: popper (neutral form plus bk.pl,
                        exs.pl, bias.pl), neutral, ilasp (neutral form plus
                        ilasp/task.las), rules (neutral form plus
                        rules/features.json), or amie (amie/facts.tsv and
                        amie/relations.json)
  --out OUT             new directory for the export
